item.title: The Foundation achieves UNI/PDR 125:2022 certification for its Gender Equality Management System
item.description:
Achieving UNI/PDR 125:2022 certification for its Gender Equality Management System adds to the certifications already obtained by the Company in the areas of Quality (ISO 9001), Environmental Management (ISO 14001) and Occupational Health and Safety (ISO 45001). This marks a further step in the Company’s ongoing efforts to strengthen its organisational framework, bringing it increasingly into line with recognised best practice in inclusion and sustainability.

L'articolo The Foundation achieves UNI/PDR 125:2022 certification for its Gender Equality Management System proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: Philanthropy in international dialogue: Foundations Circle 2026
item.description:
The international forum promoted by the Institute of Philanthropy was held in Hong Kong, bringing together representatives of international philanthropy to discuss the evolution of philanthropic models in Asia. Among the voices contributing to the dialogue was that of Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo. Trust, education and training, artificial intelligence and new forms of collaboration were the key themes addressed.

L'articolo Philanthropy in international dialogue: Foundations Circle 2026 proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: 2,800 new trees to regenerate Turin’s avenues
item.description:
Official launch of the tree-planting programme to renew Turin’s tree-lined avenues. The initiative brings together a range of partners and will involve the phased planting of new trees through to 2030, alongside the introduction of a scientific monitoring system to evaluate their impact on public health, air quality and the city’s resilience to climate change.

L'articolo 2,800 new trees to regenerate Turin’s avenues proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.description:

The project, made possible by “Alba dei Campioni” with support from Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo, enhances the Institute’s diagnostic capabilities by integrating advanced imaging with artificial intelligence, enabling earlier and more accurate diagnoses.

It is a call to challenge stereotypes and harmful representations of people with disabilities, fostering a culture that honours the dignity and worth of every individual.
